description: Keep the code-review graph current for this workspace.

hooks.command: sh -c 'cat >/dev/null || true; command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx code-review-graph update --skip-flows --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || true'

sh -c 'cat >/dev/null || true; command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx code-review-graph status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || true'
